id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_150.pack|cs_: "I feel it... I feel it. The Luminary's presence.
"However you hide, you can't hide that detestable light. Now hand over the Luminary quietly!
"I won't let you lay a finger on my family!
"Monsters, one after another... Irwin, what should we do...!
"The castle is surrounded now. We can't break through the front.
"Let's go to the underground passage in the storeroom. We should be able to get out that way. This way!"
